segments.ja244:1.1: Yaṃ passati na taṃ icchati, yañca na passati taṃ kiricchati;
segments.ja244:1.3: Maññāmi ciraṃ carissati, na hi taṃ lacchati yaṃ sa icchati.
segments.ja244:2.1: Yaṃ labhati na tena tussati, yañca pattheti laddhaṃ hīḷeti;
segments.ja244:2.3: Icchā hi anantagocarā, vigaticchāna [vīticchānaṃ (sī. pī.)] namo karomaseti.
